messages.name: array
messages.digest: Apply the given index map to this array.
messages.description: Outputs the given array, but with the elements reordered according to the given index map. Indexes start at 0, and duplicates are allowed. For example, applying the index map [2, 1, 1, 0] to the array [A, B, C] would result in the array [C, B, B, A].
